title: Yuri Tools SDS-plus Concrete Drill Bit, 16mm Diameter, 160mm Total Length, 100mm Working Length, for AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo
description: The Yuri Tools 16mm Concrete Drill Bit is a robust and reliable drilling solution designed for heavy-duty masonry work. With a total length of 160mm and a working length of 100mm, this drill bit is perfectly sized for a wide range of concrete drilling tasks. The 16mm diameter ensures clean, precise holes in concrete, brick, and stone surfaces. Featuring an SDS-plus shank type, it offers a secure and stable fit, minimising vibration during operation for greater accuracy and control. Manufactured to ISO 9001 standards, this drill bit is compatible with leading power tool brands including AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo, making it a versatile addition to any professional or DIY toolkit. The spiral flute design efficiently removes debris from the hole as you drill, reducing heat build-up and prolonging the life of the bit. Whether you are a seasoned tradesperson or a dedicated home improvement enthusiast, this Yuri Tools drill bit delivers consistent, dependable performance on tough materials.
